5. All blue things are smart. (rule 2) → Charlie is smart.  
6. All blue, furry things are smart. (rule 1) → Charlie is smart (redundant).  
7. If something is smart and not quiet then it is blue. (rule 3) → Charlie is smart and quiet (given), so antecedent false; no new inference.  

Since we have derived that Charlie is blue, the statement “Charlie is not blue” contradicts the derived fact.

ANSWER: False
